_texte.Ghid complet: cum devii partener My Darr: Complete guide: how to become a My Darrin partner — registration, verification and first orders.
_texte.Înscrierea e pentru firme, PFA și întrep: Registration is open to companies, PFAs and sole proprietorships.
_texte.Primești comenzi prin platformă, iar pla: You receive orders through the platform, and payment, held as a guarantee (escrow), reaches you after the job is confirmed.
_texte.Alege cum lucrezi cu My Darrin: Choose how you work with My Darrin
_texte.Un cont poate deține mai multe roluri si: One account can hold several roles at the same time.
_texte.Electricieni, instalatori, constructori,: Electricians, plumbers, builders, painters, gardeners, welders: you receive orders through the platform.
_texte.Materiale de construcții, electrice, san: Building, electrical and plumbing materials: your products appear in the platform's quotes.
_texte.Utilaje, scule, vehicule: rezervările vi: Machinery, tools, vehicles: bookings come through the platform.
_texte.Livrare locală de materiale la șantier,: Local delivery of materials to the site, in your area.
_texte.Polițe integrate în comenzile platformei: Policies built into the platform's orders, with ASF authorisation.
_texte.Restul datelor le completezi din dashboa: You fill in the rest of the details from the dashboard, at your own pace. What you write is saved automatically.
_texte.Alegi tipul de partener, scrii datele ta: You choose the partner type, enter your details and confirm your email with a 6-digit code.
_texte.În dashboard: firma (după CUI, datele vi: In the dashboard: the company (from the tax ID, the details come from ANAF), the bank account, professions, equipment and documents.
_texte.Echipa My Darrin verifică firma și docum: The My Darrin team checks the company and the documents. We let you know by email.
_texte.După aprobare semnezi contractul cu un c: After approval you sign the contract with a code received by email. With the bank account added, you receive orders.
_texte.La activare, în dashboard: CUI-ul firmei: At activation, in the dashboard: the company's tax ID (the rest of the details come from ANAF), the bank account (IBAN) and the company documents, for example the administrator's ID card / passport and the registration certificate. Some types also need certificates or licences (for example ISCIR, ASF or the ARR licence for couriers). The list for each type is on its page.
_texte.Echipa My Darrin verifică documentele și: The My Darrin team checks the documents and approves the account, and you are notified by email. Orders start after the contract is signed and the bank account is added.
_texte.Clientul plătește integral la plasarea c: The customer pays in full when placing the order, to Home Best Pal SRL. The amount is held as a guarantee (escrow) and is released after the work is confirmed.
_texte.Primești plata în cel mult: You are paid within at most
_texte.Ce comision reține platforma?: What commission does the platform take?
_texte.Niciunul din manoperă: 0%. Primești 100%: None on labour: 0%. You receive 100% of the labour price shown in the dashboard. The platform costs (platform commission, marketing and maintenance) are included in the price the customer pays and are not deducted from the labour. Materials, rental and insurance suppliers instead grant a commercial discount of 5–15%.
_texte.Cum se emite factura fiscală?: How is the tax invoice issued?
_texte.Tu emiți factura către Home Best Pal SRL: You issue the invoice to Home Best Pal SRL, the general contractor, for confirmed jobs. You can find your invoices in the partner dashboard.
_texte.Gata să primești comenzi prin My Darrin?: Ready to receive orders through My Darrin?
